name: Chapter III
summary: Barnil Stonepot searches Stranglethorn Vale for the missing leaves of Hemet Nesingwary's hunting manuscript. Its third chapter tells of Sir Erlgadin and Lady Rouack's first kill with a dwarven rifle.

sections.title: A Hunt Recorded
sections.body: Barnil Stonepot favors this part of The Green Hills of Stranglethorn. It follows Sir Erlgadin and Lady Rouack in their early exploits, including their first kill with a dwarven rifle. Then the tale breaks off at a sharp cliffhanger.

sections.title: Missing Leaves
sections.body: Barnil needs four leaves to restore the story: pages eighteen, twenty, twenty-one, and twenty-four. They were carried off with the rest of the manuscript and scattered across Stranglethorn Vale.

faq.q: Who is looking for Chapter III?
faq.answer: Barnil Stonepot is searching for Chapter III. He proofread Hemet Nesingwary's manuscript at the expedition camp in northern Stranglethorn Vale, and now he is trying to rebuild its missing pages.

faq.q: What happens in Chapter III of the book?
faq.answer: Chapter III recounts Sir Erlgadin and Lady Rouack's first kill with a dwarven rifle. The tale ends on an unresolved cliffhanger.

faq.q: Which pages are needed to finish Chapter III?
faq.answer: Barnil needs pages eighteen, twenty, twenty-one, and twenty-four to assemble Chapter III.
This follows The Green Hills of Stranglethorn, when Barnil first explained how Hemet Nesingwary's manuscript was lost.
